subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Ward <eward@streamlineai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options (post-demo)

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Great to see how StreamlineAI is using conversation summarization at scale — really good fit for Redwood. Per our call, I wanted to recap next steps and confirm a few cost/volume assumptions so we can put together a committed-use proposal and see if you qualify for our startup program.

Quick recap + asks:
- Target production volume: you mentioned 10M-20M tokens/month initially, with spikes to ~40M for batch jobs. Please confirm typical steady-state and peak.
- Model profile: 3-4k context, mostly chat/assist use (generation heavy).
- Economics target: you noted a target of roughly $700-$1,000 per 1M tokens. Can you confirm target $/1M and what margin you need for your product?
- Budget range & commitment horizon: are you evaluating monthly-only or a 12-24 month committed option? Any internal budget range for Q1/Q2?

What I’ll do: Ben will pull together a draft committed-use pricing model (tiered $/1M based on volume) and a startup discount overlay if you meet the program criteria. I’ll also attach the example pricing workbook and a one-page SOW for review.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm steady-state and peak tokens + target $/1M by EOD Friday.
2) Ben sends draft committed-use pricing and pro-forma SOW (we aim for Monday).
3) If startup-eligible, we’ll include the startup discount and term options for 12 vs 24 month.

Attachments: pricing-model-streamline.xlsx (workbook with unit economics), rdo-sow-v1.pdf (example SOW).

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0162

Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Ethan Ward <eward@streamlineai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jaya Patel <jaya@streamlineai.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options (post-demo)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the summary. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed volumes: steady-state ~12M tokens/month; expected growth to ~25M/month within 6 months. Peak batch runs (nightly) could hit ~45M tokens/month-equivalent but they’re irregular.
- Model profile matches what you noted (avg context ~3k, heavy generation).
- Economics: target is closer to $800 per 1M tokens for committed pricing; spot / pay-as-you-go targets higher (~$1,400/1M). Our CFO wants committed numbers with multi-year options — she’s flagged 12 vs 24 month comparisons.
- Budget: for now we can commit to a $20k-35k/month budget range depending on the per-token price and any startup credits.

We’re definitely interested in the startup program if Redwood has a clear cut for eligibility and simple onboarding credits. Jaya (cc’d) is our procurement lead — she’ll coordinate terms and contract timing.

Couple asks for Ben/Marissa: can you show a pro-forma with a 12-month and 24-month committed tier that reaches $800/1M (or below) at target volumes and indicate any early-payment / multi-year incentives? Also, any restrictions on token counting (input vs output) we should be aware of?

Thanks —
Ethan
Head of Platform | StreamlineAI
eward@streamlineai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Ward <eward@streamlineai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options (post-demo)

Hi Ethan —

Great — thanks for the details, that’s very helpful. Ben and I will prepare two pro-formas (12m and 24m) targeted at getting you to ~$800/1M at your expected 6-month volumes. A few clarifications so we don’t assume the wrong counting model:
- We bill per 1M "tokens consumed" (input + output) by default; we can show a comparison where you only bill on output if that helps the math but most customers prefer combined count for transparency.
- Startup program: eligibility is based on company age and ARR thresholds — if StreamlineAI is under $5M ARR and <3 years old, you typically qualify for 3-6 months of credits + a one-time onboarding discount. Please confirm company age/ARR and we’ll flag the eligibility with Growth.

Ben — can you build the workbook with: steady (12M), ramp (25M), and peak (45M) rows; both billing rules (in+out vs output-only); and 12m vs 24m terms with multi-year incentive rows (5-15% additional discount for prepay or multi-year commit).

Ethan — I’ll target Monday EOD for the drafts. If you want an internal review (legal/procurement) we can also include a short note of deal guardrails to speed contracting.

Best —
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Ward <eward@streamlineai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jaya Patel <jaya@streamlineai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood pricing & committed-use options (post-demo)

Ethan / Jaya —

Attaching the draft pricing workbook (pricing-model-streamline.xlsx) and a short example SOW (rdo-sow-v1.pdf). Highlights from the model:
- 12M steady: PAYG ~ $1,400/1M; 12m commit (12M steady) = $1,050/1M; 24m commit = $950/1M.
- Ramp to 25M: 12m commit blended = $850/1M; 24m commit blended = $770/1M.
- Peak scenario (45M): 24m commit + prepay option hits our target ~ $700-760/1M with a 10% multi-year / prepay incentive.

Notes on token counting: workbook uses input+output baseline; we included an "output-only" sheet so you can see the delta (output-only reduces volume ~22% for your workload in our sim).

Startup program: if StreamlineAI confirms eligibility (<= $5M ARR, company age <3 years) we can layer a startup credit equal to 2 months of committed spend (applied up-front) for 12m deals, or 3 months for 24m. That reduces effective $/1M in months 1-3.

Next steps:
- Ethan/Jaya confirm: (a) billing rule preference (in+out vs output-only), (b) preferred term (12 vs 24), (c) whether you plan to prepay or do monthly invoices.
- Once confirmed, I’ll prepare a pro-forma and a term sheet to hand to Legal for contracting.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
